scenes: One country. Three kinds of heat.
India spans hot and dry places, | places that swing between the two, | and hot, humid coasts. Each needs different warnings and cooling.
Protection is planned at every level: | national health advisories, | state plans such as Tamil Nadu’s, | city plans such as Delhi’s and Chennai’s, and workplace rules notified in 2026.
It began in Ahmedabad, in 2013: | South Asia’s first city heat plan, a model since taken up across the country.
Many plans; the next step is making every one reach people.
